## 分诊路由

**标签** `pm:on-hold` `package: app-shell` `domain:ui` `priority:p3` · **类型** Task · **保持 `pm:on-hold`**

**车道 —— `domain:ui`。** 落点已定位:`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`。三处「内部标识」中的两处在 `:2000` 与 `:2299`,同为
`title={\`${t('engine.studio.if.internalId', locale)}: ${current.type} · ${current.name}\`}`,i18n 键在 `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:3741`。⛔ 不在 `cloud`:cloud#1955 是关联,不是落点。

**保持 `pm:on-hold`。** 卡面写明「**发版后做**,本卡不进第一版发布路径」,这是提卡人的排期决定,分诊席不改。`priority:p3` 是解除保留后的入队等级,不是催办。

---

## ⛔ 第 3 条的前两项与一条已落地的裁定冲突 —— 动手前必须先读

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.surfaceIdentity.test.tsx` 是 **objectui#7254** 的落地钉,其自述的裁定原文:

> 顶栏 / 面包屑 / 侧栏显示元数据 **LABEL**;内部名归开发者视图或 **tooltip**。所以这些钉子断言两半 —— 被**读到**的是 label 与翻译后的 kind,而内部标识仍**可达**于 tooltip(彻底删掉会拿走开发者调绑定时唯一趁手的把手)。

该文件 `:105` 与 `:114` 明确断言 `title` 属性等于 `内部标识: dashboard · b2r4_customer_dashboard`。

所以:

| 卡面第 3 条 | 分诊读数 |
| --- | --- |
| 面包屑 tooltip 露出内部标识 | ⛔ **这是 #7254 裁定的结果,不是缺陷。**动它要先推翻 #7254 并改钉子 |
| 画布头 tooltip,同一串 | ⛔ 同上 |
| AI 面板底部「正在讨论：…」 | 未受该钉子覆盖 —— 可议,但它是**正文**不是 tooltip,与裁定的分界正相反 |
| 导航项的**可访问名** | ✅ **唯一真缺陷**,见下 |

⛔ 不要把「减少内部标识露出」当成一条统一诉求去做。裁定已经在「读到什么」与「可达什么」之间划了线,前两项落在线的正确一侧。第 3 项与第 4 项落在错误一侧,理由各不相同。

---

## 第 4 项是本卡唯一的缺陷,提卡人自己也这么判

「可访问名应当是显示名,机器 id 至多作为补充描述」—— 正确,且与 #7254 的裁定同向而非冲突:可访问名是**被读到的东西**,按裁定就该是 label。读屏用户听到 `dashboard · customer_dashboard` 而不是「客户仪表盘」,这不是观感,是可访问性缺陷。

一个可能相关的线索,留给承接者验证而非结论:#7254 钉子里的导航夹具含一条 `{ id: 'nav_obj', type: 'object', objectName: 'b2r4_customer' }`,注释写「作者从未命名的叶子 —— 侧栏过去渲染成空行」。**有 label 时可访问名是否仍回落到机器名**,与**无 label 时回落到什么**,是两个问题,⛔ 不要合并处理。

**可拆。** 若有人想在发版前修这一条,它独立可交付、独立可验收(卡面已要求 `read_page` 无障碍树输出为证),拆出一张新卡即可。⛔ 分诊席不代拆:提卡人明写「合成一卡,因为改动都落在同一屏」,那是刻意的组合决定,不是疏漏。

---

## 第 1、2 条:产品姿态,不是缺陷,分诊席不裁

- **第 1 条(画布 55% 宽度花在嵌套边框上)** —— 方向合理,但卡面自己标了**证据限度**:数字取自一台已退出的本地栈的最后一帧 DOM,「**数字需要在活栈上复量**再动手」。⛔ 这条 fence 我原样保留:596 → 326 这条链路在动手前必须在活栈上重测。一个从死栈末帧读出的版面数字不是读数。
- **第 2 条(禁用的发布按钮仍是主按钮)** —— 卡面自己说得对:样式与 `disabled` 状态是从**活 DOM** 上读的属性,可信度高于版面数字。这一条证据是硬的,`bg-primary` + 仅靠 `disabled:opacity-50` 压制、原因只写在 tooltip 里,三点都可直接核对。若第 1 条因复量受阻,这一条不必等它。

两条都不进决策箱:降级成 ghost / outline、把状态写在脸上,既不扩大接受集也不删除已发布能力。哪一种视觉处理由承接者在认领评论里申明即可。

---

**等级 p3。** 不影响功能(卡面首句),不阻塞发布(明确排在发版后)。解除保留后若第 4 项单独出队,它自身值 p2 —— 可访问性缺陷有确定受众且无绕行;其余两条留在 p3。

分诊席权限内:仅路由与定级 —— ⛔ 不认领、不派工、不写码、不裁产品姿态。

## 分诊:回到队列,`priority:p3` —— 维护者确认 AI build 第一版已经发布,"发版后做"的条件已满足

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`,objectstack 座位贴 #6015),2026-09-24T15:10Z。objectui 清理第十批(#8587 的挂起卡一次性清点):本席读完了卡面和评论(1 条,全部读到),并在本地 main(`62597c5`)上核对。本卡由提卡人排在"发版后做",是否已发版属于云端事实,本席看不到,因此问了维护者。**维护者答:「8219 发了」。**

### 本席实测(本地 main `62597c5`)

- **第 2 条(禁用的发布按钮仍是主按钮)**:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1230` 仍是 `bg-primary … disabled:opacity-50`,原因只写在 `title` 里。与卡面一致。
- **第 3 条(内部标识露出)**:前两处(面包屑、画布头的 tooltip)是 #7254 裁定的结果(`StudioDesignSurface.surfaceIdentity.test.tsx` 钉着),⛔ 不是缺陷,不要改;"AI 面板底部"那一处可以议。
- **第 4 条(导航项的可访问名是机器标识)**:导航按钮在 `:1351`,`title` 是 `type · name`,按钮文字是 `node.label || surface.name`。按可访问名的计算规则,按钮名称应来自文字内容,`title` 只是补充描述。卡面的读数来自一台已退出的本地栈,⇒ 需要在活栈上用无障碍树重新读一次,才能确定这是否仍是缺陷。
- **第 1 条(画布 55% 宽度花在嵌套边框上)**:卡面自己注明数字取自已退出的本地栈最后一帧,必须在活栈上复量后再动手。

### 定级

`priority:p3`:观感与产品姿态问题,不影响功能。摘 `pm:on-hold`,加 `pm:queue`。

### 执行要点

- 动手前在活栈上复量第 1 条的宽度链路,并用无障碍树(卡面要求 `read_page` 输出)读第 4 条。
- **第 4 条如果实测确认读屏用户听到的是机器标识**,它是可访问性缺陷,按上一轮分诊的意见可以单独拆成一张卡,排 `priority:p2`。⛔ 不要未经实测就拆。
- 第 2 条可以不等第 1 条:没有待发布草稿时,把按钮降为 ghost / outline,并把状态写在按钮上,而不是只写在 tooltip 里。
- ⛔ 不要动 #7254 裁定保留的两处 tooltip。

The dev stops on a breach and explains it in the report.

Serial constraints cleared: open PR file lists read 2026-09-25T16:21Z. No open PR touches `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` or the studio-design views.

Seat decisions (no-escalation class). Each follows from the thread's governing text or is a placement call the triage left to the claimant:
- **Item 1, canvas width.** Re-measure first, on a live render, as both triage passes require. If the chain still shows the preview spending most of its width on nested frames, keep one frame and let a lone widget fill the grid, following the filer's direction (「方向（不是指令，你判断）」). If the re-measure does not reproduce it, record the numbers and change nothing.
- **Item 2, publish button.** When there is no draft, it renders as an outline, not a primary button, and shows the reason as visible text, not only in the tooltip. Triage said 「哪一种视觉处理由承接者在认领评论里申明即可」, and this claim declares it: outline, plus visible text.
- **Item 3, internal id.** ⛔ The breadcrumb and canvas-header tooltips are untouched: they are the objectui#7254 ruling, pinned by `StudioDesignSurface.surfaceIdentity.test.tsx`. Under that same ruling (「被读到的是 label … 内部标识仍可达于 tooltip」), the AI panel's body line names the item's label, and the internal id stays reachable in its `title`.
- **Item 4, nav item's accessible name.** Measure it with the accessibility tree / role-name query, both with a label and without one; triage says these are two questions and must not be merged. If the name is the machine id, it becomes the display label, and the machine id at most becomes the description. If it already reads the label, pin it and change nothing. Per triage, it is ⛔ not split out unless measured.

## Seat answers — the three questions in the dev report `5836099192`

`domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`, 2026-09-25T16:51Z. All three are in the no-escalation class: the governing text decides each one, or it is a placement call.

**Item 1, canvas width → B with A folded in.** The live measurement moves the loss to `DashboardPreview` (the `min-w-768` grid, and a lone widget at half span). The filer's direction is the governing text: 「预览层只留一层边框；单 widget 时让它吃满栅格宽；高度跟内容走」. It names the lone-widget span and the single frame, so the fix follows the measured site. The change:
- in `previews/DashboardPreview.tsx`, a lone widget spans the full grid, and the `min-w-768` pin is kept only when there are several widgets;
- the Studio canvas wrapper drops its own frame when the preview brings `PreviewShell`;
- the preview gallery's other uses stay unchanged, and are pinned.

**Item 3, the AI "discussing" chip → A.** The objectui#7254 ruling says the label is what is read and the internal id stays reachable (「被读到的是 label … 内部标识仍可达于 tooltip」). So the chip is built as follows:
- `AiChatPage` passes the artifact's display label, taking the one the Studio already holds and passing it through `surfaceContext`; it falls back to the id when there is no label;
- `ChatbotEnhanced` gets an OPTIONAL `surfaceContextTitle` prop that carries `type · name` as its `title`.

B would drop the reachable half of the ruling, and C would leave the defect. The follow-up claim is `Clause-②: yes`, because `plugin-chatbot` gains one optional prop.

**Item 4, unlabelled leaf fallback → B (keep).** Naming an unlabelled leaf by its internal name is objectui#7254's deliberate fallback; its pin fixture says so. Changing it to the object label means revisiting that ruling, which is not a seat call, and this card does not carry it. ⛔ Nothing is filed from it here.

**Sequence.** This is serial on this seat. PR objectui#10679 (`Part of #8219`) lands first. Items 1 and 3 then go out under one re-scoped claim on this card, which will close it.

## 🟢 LANDED (part 1) — PR objectui#10679 merged as `bb6db2791` (merge queue)

`domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`, 2026-09-25T17:25Z. Merged 2026-09-25T17:24Z. `Clause-②: no`.

Verified by content on objectui `origin/main`:
- With no draft, Studio's Publish button is an outline with a visible reason (`publish-none-reason`).
- The pin `StudioDesignSurface.interfacePolish.test.tsx` is present, and it also holds the item 4 accessible-name rows.
